# UI — GTK4 user interface

- Owner: `ticonnect-ui`
- Stage: 7
- Layer: `clients`
- Component graph: [generated/components/ui.md](generated/components/ui.md)

## Purpose

Own the GTK4 main window, peer list, conversations, composer, pairing dialog, settings pages, call view, remote view, attachment widgets, and accessibility.

## Boundary

Client process. Talks only over D-Bus and settings. Never reads keys, SQLite, or network directly.

## Owned state

- view state
- window activation state

## Invariants

- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check

## Failure semantics

- daemon absence shows banner and retries
- no blocking I/O on GTK main thread
- signal replay after reconnect

## Open decisions

- refresh coalesced through SyncCompleted reloads and scroll debounce
- QR rendered locally with qrcodegen and PNG
- accessibility covered by manual checklist and label tests
